questions.q: What is the most improbable event you can think of in human history?
questions.answer: Maybe getting struck by lightning the second you step outside. Very unlikely, but the lesson asks whether something just being unlikely is the same as a miracle.

questions.q: Is a good parking spot or a baby's birth a miracle like those in Scripture?
questions.answer: Probably not. Those are good things, but the miracles in Scripture, like the fire Elijah saw fall in 1 Kings 18, are God stepping in to do what nature can't, showing who He is.

questions.q: If miracles still happen, why do you think you rarely see them near you?
questions.answer: They may just be rare where we live, and we're often taught to assume science explains everything. But we can't say they don't happen; God can still do them if He chooses.
